scope: Exact unchanged pinned Debian Firefox ESR ARM64, software/headless Wayland at 100 percent scale, ordinary wrapped native textareas. Zoom fallback/restoration is not native scaled support.

implementation.provider: Existing ordinary NSTextView/NSScrollView through the unchanged NativeUI wheel operation. No copied control, geometry, clamping, line/page/Shift behavior or shortcut table.
implementation.hit_testing: Use original nsIFrame hit info plus the existing eApzAwareListeners flag for owned native textareas, as the built-in range handler does. No dummy DOM listener or global APZ override.
implementation.default: Real EventStateManager post-DOM/default boundary retains page cancellation. Original default-handler PreventDefault acknowledges native consumption to APZ while preserving the content defaultPrevented getter.
implementation.action: Call original APZWheelActionFor; guarded exact-build Maybe::Some(Scroll) representation. Browser zoom/history preferences remain engine-owned.
implementation.normalization: Pixel distance is retained; GTK discrete wheel ticks use ten surface units per step, matching the native backend. AppKit owns resulting native movement.
implementation.lifetime: Retain semantic nodes across native/engine calls and revalidate node/control/frame identity before echoing native offsets through the original engine setter.
implementation.focus: Track the focus represented by the cached native bitmap. A retained display-list paint refreshes native focus/pixels on transition, without transferring engine scroll offsets or drawing a caret.
implementation.recovery: Existing viewport host-epoch restoration recreates the native object from retained live browser model. No input replay.
implementation.fixture: Browser-family-neutral real-seat reference fixture; private browser port checked before launch. Session logs write directly to evidence files so synchronous browser/native RPCs cannot fill a log pipe; Marionette close errors no longer skip owned-tree teardown.
implementation.feature: NEXTSPACE_FIREFOX_WHEEL=1 plus native multiline viewport, input/text/multiline flags, provider wheel capability and exact libxul build/instruction guards. Not installed as a desktop default.

remaining: Root-document wheel/native scrolling, touch momentum, horizontal/nowrap text and long-document caret/ancestor scrolling.
Native IME, accessibility, scaling/HiDPI, remaining browser frontend controls and detached-menu integration gaps.
Other Firefox/Chromium builds and derivatives, installed-desktop rollout, then GTK/Qt/KDE and other non-GNUstep applications.

input_scope: Six actual compositor-seat full/fractional wheel cases against an ordinary GNUstep window. Other Firefox wheel/modifier/cancellation/image checks use trusted fixture-owned Marionette/WebDriver input. Keyboard/clipboard regressions in both families use actual compositor-seat keys. No physical wheel-after-recovery or touch/momentum claim.
native_pixel_scope: Nine complete RGB browser/provider comparisons in the direct Firefox wheel run, ten in the supervised/recovery run, fourteen in the viewport regression. The unchanged shared provider was independently compared with direct ordinary AppKit controls in the preceding NativeUI qualification.
binary_boundary: Only the small Firefox adapter rebuilt for this checkpoint. Browser executables/libxul, installed AppKit, NativeUI loader/provider/shim and the private Wayland backend match the preceding viewport hashes.

retained_failures.apz: Initial DoScrollText hook was bypassed by compositor APZ ownership; replaced with the existing APZ-aware hit-test flag plus real post-DOM default and engine acknowledgement.
retained_failures.observer: First recovery observer check failed after the test intentionally removed its page observer. Native wheel already worked. Reinstall the observer before requiring observer evidence.
retained_failures.disabled: An initial disabled-case test demanded a scroll event; an independent appearance:none disabled engine control proves Firefox suppresses it. Preserve the engine policy.
retained_failures.viewport_fixture: Old test demanded a new event while reapplying an unchanged offset and could crop an offscreen field on a reused page. Establish root zero and a committed distinct starting offset.
retained_failures.logging: The old session-03 harness deadlocked when a synchronous request stopped draining its stdout pipe; the timeout then left DeleteSession out of sequence. Direct file logging and reliable cleanup pass the combined run.
retained_failures.blurred_caret: Candidate 03 left a one-pixel cached native caret after retained-list blur. Candidate 04 tracks bitmap focus and refreshes the existing native focus/image; all fourteen viewport images now pass.

firefox-wheel-session-03.method: Saved launch/window/hook process IDs plus unique runtime/output command-line scan; original harness did not produce a complete descendant cleanup receipt.

automation_cleanup: Both owned Chromium agent-browser connections closed before teardown; task SSH forwards 9952/9248 and 9953/9249 cancelled. Session-03 lacks its original complete descendant cleanup receipt; the recorded follow-up audit covers saved launch/window/hook process IDs and unique runtime/output command lines, with no live matches.
